description: Re-deploy skills WITHOUT changing any definitions. ⚠️ HEAVY OPERATION: regenerates MCP servers (Python code) for every skill, pushes each to A-Team Core, restarts connectors, and verifies tool discovery. Takes 30-120s depending on skill count; over a hosted connection the call answers within 45s, and a redeploy not done by then answers status:'running' with a job_id (ateam_redeploy({solution_id, job_id, resume:true}) waits for it again). Use after connector restarts, Core hiccups, or stale state. For incremental changes, prefer ateam_patch (which updates + redeploys in one step).

job_id.description: With resume:true: the job_id a status:"running" answer gave.

resume.description: true with job_id: wait again for a redeploy that answered status:"running" and answer with its result. Deploys nothing new.

skill_id.description: Optional: redeploy a single skill only. Omit to redeploy ALL skills in the solution.

name: ateam_redeploy
